simple.meaning: צֵלָע (tsêlâʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, i.e. leaf); hence, a side , literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, i.e. quarter); architecturally, a (especially floor or ceiling) timber or plank (single or collective, i.e. a flooring).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 41 times across Genesis, Exodus, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, Job, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 2:21. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.

definitions.full: H6763. tsela צֵלָע 41 noun feminine ( masculine 1Kin 6:34 , and apparently Exod 26:26 ) rib, side ; — absolute ׳צ Gen 2:22 +, construct צֶ֫לַע Exod 26:26 +, also צֵ֫לַע 2Sam 16:13 ; suffix צַלְעוֺ Exod 25:12 +; plural צְלָעִים 1Kin 6:34 , צְלָעוֺת 6:3 +; construct צַלְעֹת Ezek 41:26 +; suffix צַלְעֹתָיו Gen 2:21 +; — 1 rib of man Gen 2:21-22 , (J). 2 rib of hill, i.e. ridge, or terrace 2Sam 16:13 . 3 side-chambers or cells (enclosing temple like ribs) 1Kin 6:5-6 , (read ׳הַצּ for היצוע , see [ יָצִיעַ ]), 7:3 , so of Ezekiel's temple Ezek 41:5 10 t. 41 (on text see Co Toy Krae). 4 ribs of cedar and fir, i.e. planks, boards (plural), of temple wall 1Kin 6:15-16 , floor 6:15 . 5 leaves of door 1Kin 6:34 . 6 (in P) side , of ark ( אֶרוֺן ) Exod 25:12 (twice in verse); 25:14 = 37:3 (twice in verse); 37:5 ; of tabernacle ( מִשְׁכָּן ) 26:20 (|| מֵּאָה 26:18 ), 26:26 ; 26:27 ; 26:27 = 36:25 (|| ׳פ 36:23 ), 36:31 ; 36:32 , 26:35 (twice in verse); of altar 27:7 = 38:7 , 30:4 = 37:27 . — Jer 20:10 ; Job 18:12 see צֶלַע below II. צלע .
